request: Create a Python function that calculates the factorial of a number. Write a pytest test file to validate it, including edge cases (0, 1, negative input). Run the tests. If any test fails, fix the implementation until all tests pass. Ensure the final solution is correct and documented.
title: Develop and test a Python factorial function
goals: Implement a Python function to calculate the factorial of a number
Create a pytest test file to validate the factorial function
Include edge cases such as 0, 1, and negative inputs in the tests
Ensure all tests pass and fix the implementation if necessary
Document the final solution with appropriate comments
constraints: Testing must be done using pytest
Do not use external libraries for factorial calculation
success_criteria: Factorial function correctly calculates factorial for positive integers
Tests cover edge cases including 0, 1, and negative inputs
Code is documented with comments explaining the logic
